message.content: {"class":"TEST_DATA","reasoning":"The stale-account-state tie-break classifies a wrong value in a consumed subscription record as TEST_DATA, even when an earlier CI run caused it. The audit log shows shared subscription SUB-70001 was cancelled during nightly #2117 before this test attempted renewal, and the API rejected renewal with 409 and state CANCELLED. The test inherited this record rather than creating it during the current run."}
